item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must ban its development before that happens.

2. We cannot allow companies or governments to gamble with billions of lives. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will cause catastrophe. The only responsible policy is a ban.

3. Superintelligence is not just another technology. If it is built within the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We are working to stop its development before it is too late.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not a distant or abstract concern. The systems now being developed are moving toward capabilities that humanity does not know how to control, while companies and governments continue to race ahead. We cannot accept a future in which a small number of actors gamble with billions of lives. That is why we are working for a ban on superintelligence: not a pause, not voluntary safeguards, and not promises to solve control later. The stakes demand a clear line, enforced before the technology is built.
